MA.threshold: The initial label distance after which the first maintenance alert label should be printed. For alert type R, any number between 0 and 150 may be used; units are kilometers. For alert type C, any number between 0 and 2,000 may be used; units are meters. The default value is 50 km for alert type R, and 0 m for alert type C.
MA.frequency: The label distance after which the maintenance alert label should reprint, in meters. Any number between 0 and 2,000 may be used. The default value is 0.
MA.units: The units to use when reporting maintenance information. Valid values are C (centimeters), I (inches) and M (meters). The default value is I (inches).

MC.clear: Whether or not to clear the previous label contents before drawing the next label. Valid values are Y (clear the previous label contents) and N (do not clear the previous label contents). The default value is Y (clear the previous label contents).

MD.darknessModifier: The amount to increase or decrease the darkness level. Any number between -30 and 30 may be used. Negative numbers result in lighter print output, while positive numbers result in darker print output. There is no default value.

MF.powerupAction: The media feed action to take on power-up. Valid values are F (feed media to first inter-label mark), C (recalibrate media sensor), L (reset the label length), N (do nothing), and S (perform a short calibration). The default value is C (recalibrate media sensor).
MF.closingAction: The media feed action to take on head-close. Valid values are F (feed media to first inter-label mark), C (recalibrate media sensor), L (reset the label length), N (do nothing), and S (perform a short calibration). The default value is C (recalibrate media sensor).

MI.type: The type of maintenance alert to configure. Valid values are R (print head replacement alerts) and C (print head cleaning alerts). The default value is R (print head replacement alerts).
MI.message: The message to print on the maintenance alert label. The maximum length is 63 characters. The default value is "PLEASE REPLACE PRINT HEAD" for alert type R, and "PLEASE CLEAN PRINT HEAD" for alert type C.

ML.maxLength: The maximum label length, in dots. There is no default value.

MM.mode: The post-print action to be taken by the printer after each label is printed. Valid values are T (advance label to tear-off bar for manual tear-off), P (advance label and wait for manual peel-off), R (rewind label on an external rewind device), A (advance label for applicator device), C (advance label for automated cutting), D (wait for delayed cut command), F (encode RFID data without backfeed), and K (present label for removal from kiosk). The default value is T (advance label to tear-off bar for manual tear-off).
MM.prepeel: Whether or not to pre-peel each label before printing. Valid values are Y (pre-peel labels) and N (do not pre-peel labels). The default value is N (do not pre-peel labels).

MN.media: The label media type being used. Valid values are N (continuous media), V (variable-length continuous media), W or Y (non-continuous web-sensing media), M (non-continuous mark-sensing media), and A (auto-detect media type during calibration). There is no default value.
MN.offset: The offset of the media mark relative to the actual label break, in dots. Valid values are hardware-specific, but values between -75 and 283 are usually valid. The default value is 0.

MP.function: The control panel function to be disabled. Valid values are D (disable darkness mode), P (disable position mode), C (disable calibration mode), W (disable pause), F (disable feed), X (disable cancel), M (disable menu adjustments), S (disable mode saves), and E (re-enable all modes). There is no default value.

MT.mediaType: The label media type being used. Valid values are D (direct thermal media) and T (thermal transfer media). There is no default value.

MU.units: The units to use to specify label coordinates and distances. Valid values are D (dots), I (inches), and M (millimeters). There is no default value.
MU.baseDpi: The label definition base DPI. This parameter is ignored if units are not D (dots). Valid values are 150, 200, 300 and 600. There is no default value.
MU.desiredDpi: The label definition desired DPI. This parameter is ignored if units are not D (dots). Valid values are 150, 200, 300 and 600. This value must be a whole integer multiple of the base DPI. There is no default value.

MW.enable: Whether or not to enable the head cold warning. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). There is no default value.

PA.defaultGlyph: Whether to use a space character or the .notdef glyph when a font is unable to display a character. The .notdef glyph is usually a blank vertical rectangle. Valid values are 0 (use a space character) and 1 (use the .notdef glyph). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (use a space character) if no value was previously configured.
PA.bidi: Whether or not to enable bidirectional text layout, which is important for Arabic and Hebrew scripts. Valid values are 0 (disable bidi layout) and 1 (enable bidi layout). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (disable bidi layout) if no value was previously configured.
PA.charShaping: Whether or not to enable character shaping, which is important for Arabic and Indic scripts. Valid values are 0 (disable character shaping) and 1 (enable character shaping). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (disable character shaping) if no value was previously configured.
PA.openTypeSupport: Whether or not to enable support for advanced OpenType font features, like ligatures. Valid values are 0 (disable OpenType features) and 1 (enable OpenType features). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (disable OpenType features) if no value was previously configured.

PF.rows: The number of dot rows (starting at the bottom of the label) to slew. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. There is no default value.

~PL.length: The length of the extra label section to eject, in millimeters. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is 0.

PM.mirror: Whether or not to mirror label content. Valid values are Y (mirror label content) and N (do not mirror label content). There is no default value.

~PM.serialNumber: The printer serial number. The correct serial number must be used. There is no default value.
~PM.wipeCount: The number of times to wipe printer memory. Any number between 0 and 3 may be used. The default value is 0.

PN.length: The length of the label section to eject, in millimeters. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. There is no default value.

PO.orientation: Whether or not to invert label content. Valid values are I (invert label content) and N (do not invert label content). The default value is N (do not invert label content).

PQ.labels: The number of labels generated by the current label definition. Any number between 1 and 99,999,999 may be used. The default value is 1.
PQ.labelsBetweenPauses: The number of labels between print pauses. Any number between 0 and 99,999,999 may be used. The default value is 0 (no pauses).
PQ.replicates: The number of label replicates to generate for each serial number. Any number between 0 and 99,999,999 may be used. The default value is 0 (no replicates).
PQ.noPause: Whether or not to prevent printer pauses. Valid values are Y (prevent pauses) and N (do not prevent pauses). The default value is N (do not prevent pauses).
PQ.cutOnError: Whether or not to cut the labels after an error label. Valid values are Y (cut after error label) and N (do not cut after error label). The default value is Y (cut after error label).

PR.printSpeed: The print speed, in inches per second. Any number between 1 and 14 may be used. The default value is 2.
PR.slewSpeed: The slew speed, in inches per second. Any number between 1 and 14 may be used. The default value is 6.
PR.backfeedSpeed: The backfeed speed, in inches per second. Any number between 1 and 14 may be used. The default value is 2.

PW.width: The label print width, in dots. Any number between 2 and the label width may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or the label width if no value was previously configured.

SC.baud: The baud rate to use, in bits per second. Valid values are 110, 300, 600, 1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 14400, 19200, 28800, 38400, 57600, and 115200. There is no default value.
SC.wordBits: The number of data bits in each character. Valid values are 7 and 8. There is no default value.
SC.parity: The type of parity bit to use for error detection. Valid values are N (none), O (odd), and E (even). There is no default value.
SC.stopBits: The number of stop bits to send after each character. Valid values are 1 and 2. There is no default value.
SC.mode: The flow control mode to use during handshaking. Valid values are X (XON/XOFF), D (DTR/DSR), R (RTS), and M (DTR/DSR XON/XOFF). There is no default value.
SC.protocol: The communication protocol to use. Valid values are A (ACK/NAK), N (none), and Z (reserved). There is no default value.

~SD.darkness: The print darkness level. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. Higher numbers result in darker print output. The default value is the previously configured value.

SE.path: The file path to load the encoding table from. The file must use the .DAT extension. There is no default value.

SF.mask: The mask to apply to the field data when determining how to increment it. Must match the starting value specified in the ^FD command. Valid characters are D (representing decimal numbers), H (representing hexadecimal numbers), O (representing octal numbers), A (representing ASCII letters), N (representing alphanumeric ASCII characters), and % (representing ignored characters). There is no default value.
SF.increment: The increment to apply to the field data for each additional label. The default value is 1.

SI.setting: The specific setting to configure. Valid values are 1 (brightness) and 2 (baseline). There is no default value.
SI.value: The intensity value. Any number between 0 and 196 may be used. There is no default value.

SL.mode: The clock mode. Valid values are S (use time at start of ZPL parsing), T (use time at start of print queueing), or any number between 1 and 999 (use time at last clock tick, using the specified clock resolution, in seconds).
SL.language: The language to use to localize date/time field data. Valid values are 1 (English), 2 (Spanish), 3 (French), 4 (German), 5 (Italian), 6 (Norwegian), 7 (Portuguese), 8 (Swedish), 9 (Danish), 10 (Spanish), 11 (Dutch), 12 (Finnish), 13 (Japanese), 14 (Korean), 15 (Simplified Chinese), 16 (Traditional Chinese), 17 (Russian), 18 (Polish), 19 (Czech), and 20 (Romanian). The default value is the previously configured value, or the control panel language if no value was previously configured.

SN.start: The starting number. The default value is 1.
SN.increment: The increment (or decrement) to apply to the field data for each additional label. Any number, positive or negative, containing up to 12 digits, may be used. The default value is 1.
SN.pad: Whether or not to pad the numbers with zeroes to match the original start number width. Valid values are Y (pad with zeroes) and N (do not pad with zeroes. The default value is N (do not pad with zeroes).

SO.clock: The clock to modify. Valid values are 2 (secondary) and 3 (tertiary). There is no default value.
SO.months: The months offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.
SO.days: The days offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.
SO.years: The years offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.
SO.hours: The hours offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.
SO.minutes: The minutes offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.
SO.seconds: The seconds offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

SP.row: The dot row number at which to start printing the current label segment. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

SQ.condition: The error condition for the alert to stop or start. Valid values are the letters A through W (for individual errors) and * (for all errors).
SQ.destination: The destination of the alert to stop or start. Valid values are A (serial port), B (parallel port), C (email), D (TCP), E (UDP), F (SNMP) and * (all destinations).
SQ.stop: Whether to stop or start the alert. Valid values are Y (stop the alerts) and N (start the alerts). The default value is Y (stop the alerts).

SR.resistance: The printhead resistance. Any number between 488 and 1175 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value.

SS.web: The web sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.media: The media sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.ribbon: The ribbon sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.length: The label length, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.int1: The media LED intensity. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.int2: The ribbon LED intensity. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.sense: The black mark sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.mediaSense: The media black mark sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.
SS.ledSense: The black mark sensor LED intensity. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

ST.month: The month. Any number between 1 and 12 may be used. The default value is the current month.
ST.day: The day. Any number between 1 and 31 may be used. The default value is the current day.
ST.year: The year. Any number between 1998 and 2097 may be used. The default value is the current year.
ST.hour: The hour. Any number between 0 and 23 may be used. The default value is the current hour.
ST.minute: The minute. Any number between 0 and 59 may be used. The default value is the current minute.
ST.second: The second. Any number between 0 and 59 may be used. The default value is the current second.
ST.format: The hour format that was used in the fourth parameter. Valid values are A (AM), P (PM) and M (military). The default value is M (military).

SX.condition: The error condition for the alert to configure. Valid values are the letters A through W (for individual errors) and * (for all errors).
SX.destination: The destination of the alert to configure. Valid values are A (serial port), B (parallel port), C (email), D (TCP), E (UDP) and F (SNMP).
SX.set: Whether or not to alert on set. Valid values are Y (alert on set) and N (do not alert on set). The default value is the previously configured value.
SX.clear: Whether or not to alert on clear. Valid values are Y (alert on clear) and N (do not alert on clear). The default value is the previously configured value.
SX.setting: Destination details, depending on the destination type configured: an email address, or an IP address, or an SNMP trap.
SX.port: Destination port, depending on the destination type configured: a TCP port number, or a UDP port number.

SZ.version: The ZPL version. Valid values are 1 (ZPL) and 2 (ZPL II). Use of the value 1 (ZPL) is highly discouraged. The default value is 2 (ZPL II).

~TA.adjustment: The tear-off position adjustment, in dots. Any number between -120 and 120 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

TB.orientation: The text block orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^A or ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).
TB.maxWidth: The maximum text block width, in dots. Text longer than this width is wrapped to another line. Any number between 1 and the label width may be used. The default value is 1, which is rarely useful.
TB.maxHeight: The maximum text block height, in dots. Any text which exceeds this limit is truncated. Any number between 1 and the label height may be used. The default value is 1, which is rarely useful.

TO.from: The file path(s) to copy the file(s) from. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted.
TO.to: The file path(s) to copy the file(s) to. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted.

XF.path: The file path to load the label definition from. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.ZPL.

XG.path: The path to the image graphics file. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.
XG.magnificationX: The horizontal magnification to apply to the image. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value is 1.
XG.magnificationY: The vertical magnification to apply to the image. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value is 1.

XS.length: Whether or not to dynamically calibrate label length. Valid values are Y (enable dynamic label length calibration) and N (disable dynamic label length calibration). The default value is Y (enable dynamic label length calibration).
XS.threshold: Whether or not to dynamically calibrate label threshold. Valid values are Y (enable dynamic label threshold calibration) and N (disable dynamic label threshold calibration). The default value is Y (enable dynamic label threshold calibration).
XS.gain: Whether or not to dynamically calibrate label gain. Valid values are Y (enable dynamic label gain calibration) and N (disable dynamic label gain calibration). The default value is Y (enable dynamic label gain calibration).

ZZ.seconds: The number of seconds to wait until shutdown. Any number between 0 and 999,999 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.
ZZ.immediate: Whether or not to sleep immediately. Valid values are Y (sleep immediately, even if labels are still queued for printing) and N (wait until all pending labels have been printed before sleeping). The default value is N (wait until all pending labels have been printed).

pwll.label: By ^PW / ^LL only
pwll.desc:
The document size follows the ^PW (width) and ^LL (length) commands in the ZPL code.

• The size is redefined when ^PW or ^LL is added or its value changes.
• Other code changes never affect the size: you remain free to set it manually.

elems.label: By ^PW / ^LL, else by elements
elems.desc:
Same as the previous option, with a fallback computation:

• If ^PW or ^LL is missing, the missing dimension is computed from the extent of the document's elements, and recomputed on every code change.
• ^PW and ^LL always take priority over the computation.
